metaDescription: Link your WooCommerce store to Zapier using REST API keys to automatically sync new orders, customers, and inventory updates.
intro: Manually exporting order data from a WooCommerce store slows down fulfillment and reporting. This guide shows how to prepare your WordPress site for API access, generate secure Consumer Key and Secret credentials, and connect WooCommerce to Zapier so new orders and customer events trigger automated workflows.

steps.heading: Check WooCommerce prerequisites
steps.body: Open your WordPress dashboard and confirm your WooCommerce settings are ready for external API access.

steps.heading: Choose your connection method
steps.body: Decide between the legacy webhook method and the official WooCommerce Zapier extension.

steps.heading: Generate API keys
steps.body: Create a new key with the correct Read/Write permissions, generating a Consumer Key and Consumer Secret.

steps.heading: Add WooCommerce in Zapier
steps.body: Access the Zapier dashboard and add the WooCommerce app to your workspace.

steps.heading: Authenticate the connection
steps.body: Connect using your website URL and the generated API credentials.

steps.heading: Set up a trigger and test
steps.body: Configure a trigger event, such as New Order Placed, and fetch fresh JSON payload data to verify successful communication.

faq.question: What credentials do I need to connect WooCommerce to Zapier?
faq.answer: You need a Consumer Key and Consumer Secret generated from your WooCommerce REST API settings with the correct Read/Write permissions.

faq.question: Is there more than one way to connect WooCommerce?
faq.answer: Yes, you can choose between the legacy webhook method and the official WooCommerce Zapier extension.

faq.question: What events can trigger a Zap from WooCommerce?
faq.answer: Triggers include events like New Order Placed or Subscription Status Changed.

faq.question: How do I confirm the connection works?
faq.answer: Fetch fresh JSON payload data after setup to verify successful webhook communication between WooCommerce and Zapier.
